_comment: Secrets: the Transport Pro credentials go into the stack's secret (deploy.py --tpro-secret),
the two Google keys into the state bucket (deploy.py --sa-key / --chat-key).
ChatAudience = the Google Cloud project NUMBER of the credit bot's Chat app;
blank makes the callback reject every click (fail closed).
Reviewers = JSON list of addresses allowed to click Approve / Move / Reject.
ScheduleEnabled = false deploys the worker without the 5-minute trigger; invoke once by hand, then set true.
